name: Syed Hamid Ashraf
title: Data Engineer
summary: Data Engineer with over 3.5 years of hands-on experience developing and supporting cloud-based data platforms. Skilled in SQL, Azure Data Factory, Azure Databricks (PySpark), and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, with practical experience in batch data pipelines, data validation, and on-prem to Azure migration initiatives.

certifications.title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate

highlights: Designed, developed, and supported Azure-based batch data pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks, processing 20+ GB/day of data
Implemented data ingestion pipelines from MSSQL Server into ADLS Gen2, enabling 100% automated daily and weekly batch processing
Optimized PySpark transformations using efficient joins, partitioning, and selective caching, reducing ETL execution time by 25–30%
Contributed to workflow orchestration using Apache Airflow, maintaining ~97% pipeline uptime
Assisted in compute cost optimization by analyzing Databricks cluster usage patterns, reducing spend by ~15–20%

achievements: Received Accenture Ace Award for outstanding performance and contributions
Selected as a Core Member of TEDx Hyderabad; coordinated a 10-member team to support operations for 16 speakers and 500+ attendees
